Aisha (CS Ops): Heads up — onboarding velocity dipped for EMEA accounts last 7d, noticed more stalled 'started' -> no activity for >72h. Can we auto-sample and create a playbook task for owners?
Tom H (Data): do you have a sample query? I can hook into the scheduler. :mag:
Aisha (CS Ops): here's a quick query idea — using last_activity and onboarding_step
```
SELECT account_id, owner, onboarding_step, last_activity_at
FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_status = 'started' AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '72 hours'
AND region = 'EMEA'
LIMIT 200
```
Priya R: +1. Also need dedupe on duplicate accounts and filter out expired trials. We get noise from imports. Maybe join on external_id.
Ben D (Platform): we can wire this to playbook automation as a dry-run first. I'll add a flag `dry_run=true` so we send a report not tasks.
Aisha (CS Ops): good call. For thresholds: propose healthscore < 40 OR no activity AND onboarding_step in ('product-setup','first-success'). Thoughts? @Tom H
Tom H (Data): sounds reasonable. I'll add two derived fields: `onboard_idle_hours` and `owner_contact_count` to reduce false positives.
onboard-bot: Scheduled job created (id: pid-8342). Dry-run report will run nightly at 02:00 UTC. :robot_face:
Priya R: can we have the report include last 3 interactions and last NPS if available? helps owners triage.
Ben D (Platform): yep — backend will attach last_interactions array and nps_score if present. I'll post the dry-run summary here when it completes.
Aisha (CS Ops): thanks team — action items: Tom to finalize query and run sample, Ben to enable dry-run, Priya to confirm triage fields. I'll review the first report and propose playbook message templates. :thumbsup:
